sites: the identity gate read identity_surface_jointly_satisfied from temporal_identity_contract_material, which the CALLER supplied and merely hashed
temporal_identity_contract_ref was bound only by semantic_hash(caller material)
the TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE snapshot was resolved independently, with no link to the identity material at all

reproduced_before_any_change.authority_half: a completely unrelated positive TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE snapshot present in the registry
reproduced_before_any_change.result: TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONAL_CLAIM_AUTHORIZED -- the self-authored material authorized the comparison

defect.why_hash_binding_is_insufficient: the ref hashed the caller's own material, so the binding proved only that the caller was self-consistent. Nothing connected the identity contract to the authority that owns identity material.

repair.principle: the joint-satisfaction fact is read from the ADOPTED TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority, which owns identity material. Caller material may IDENTIFY what is requested; it may not AUTHORIZE.
repair.mechanism: TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE's resolved positive snapshot is captured by slot, and its scope_envelope is consulted for two facts: temporal_identity_contract_refs (which identity contracts this authority governs, matched by COMPLETE ExactRef identity) and identity_surface_jointly_satisfied
repair.exact_identity_matching: _scope_covers_exact_ref_set compares COMPLETE ExactRef identity (kind + object_id + content_hash) and deliberately mirrors _scope_covers_governed_use, so identity coverage and governed-use coverage are judged by one rule. A bare object_id token is not coverage and absence is not coverage.
repair.no_new_owner: no new identity owner, registry, or authority kind was invented. This reads the existing TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE snapshot that F7 already resolves and already requires to be positive.
repair.caller_material_role_after_repair: cross-check only. If caller material contradicts the owner, the comparison is refused; it can never supply the fact.
repair.state_mapping: both new codes map onto the EXISTING TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED state. No new relation state was added; RELATION_STATES remains exactly 12.
repair.why_that_mapping_was_necessary: the new codes initially did not appear in STATE_REASON_PRECEDENCE, so the identity failure was recorded in `detected` yet the receipt still resolved positive. The court caught this: the caller-minted witness still saw TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONAL_CLAIM_AUTHORIZED. Mapping the codes into the existing state closed it.

targeted_break.proves: an owner reporting the identity surface unsatisfied yields TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED while the same fixture with the owner satisfied yields the positive receipt, so the owner's answer -- not caller material -- decides the outcome

hq217_tests_updated_not_weakened.change: un-satisfaction is now expressed as an OWNER fact via _full_registry(te_identity_satisfied=False) rather than by handing the caller unsatisfying material, because caller material is no longer the lever
hq217_tests_updated_not_weakened.note: the contradiction branch is reached honestly: a first attempt failed because the earlier hash-binding gate refused first, which is stricter, so a ref whose hash DOES match unsatisfying material is used and bound by the owner

hq217_tests_updated_not_weakened.change: same lever change; the precedence assertion and direction claim are unchanged

fixture_change: _full_registry now places temporal_identity_contract_refs and identity_surface_jointly_satisfied on the TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE scope envelope, with switches (te_identity_refs, te_identity_satisfied) so the court can also build the hostile variants
no_new_authority: identity is read from an authority F7 already requires to be positive; no identity-granting authority was created
